create.name: La Grace, Sri Aurobindo Integral Life Center
create.bio:
La Grace is a non-profit centre devoted to Sri Aurobindo's and the Mother's Integral Yoga, based on a rural property in the foothills near Fountain Inn, about half an hour from Greenville in upstate South Carolina. It describes its aim as learning that changes people and a growth of consciousness, and it serves long-time followers of the Integral Yoga as well as seekers from other faiths. It has a sister centre in Surat, India, and a research arm working on applied integral studies.

Much of its teaching now happens online. A library of self-paced courses runs from free introductory series on Integral Yoga to paid courses with Dr Soumitra Basu on consciousness and with Dr Vladimir Yatsenko on Sanskrit and the Upanishads. Weekly and fortnightly study circles meet on Zoom to read Savitri and Ilion together, and an online Sunday Sangha gathers twice a month around a theme from the practice. Each summer La Grace hosts an Integral Yoga retreat with invited speakers, and it publishes a Knowledge Bank of talks and articles and the Aspire publications.

courses.title: Integral Yoga, a Consciousness-Based Approach
courses.description: A long self-paced online course of 38 lessons with Dr Soumitra Basu, looking at Sri Aurobindo's yoga through the lens of consciousness and its levels.

courses.title: Cosmic Consciousness in the light of Sri Aurobindo
courses.description: An eight-lesson self-paced course with Dr Soumitra Basu, made with the journal NAMAH, on what Sri Aurobindo meant by cosmic consciousness and how it opens in practice.

courses.title: Aitareya and Taittiriya Upanishads
courses.description: Self-paced study of two Upanishads with Dr Vladimir Yatsenko, reading the Sanskrit in the light of Sri Aurobindo's interpretation of the Vedic texts.

courses.title: A Course in Sanskrit Grammar, Semester 1
courses.description: The first semester of Dr Vladimir Yatsenko's Sanskrit grammar programme, twenty self-paced lessons for students who want to read the scriptures and Sri Aurobindo's Vedic writings in the original.

free_resources.title: Integral Yoga, Level I.A.
free_resources.description: The opening part of a free self-paced series on Integral Yoga led by Radhe, introducing Sri Aurobindo and the Mother and the basic ideas of their yoga.

free_resources.title: Monday Night Savitri Circle
free_resources.description: A free weekly Zoom gathering at 5 pm New York time to read and talk through passages of Sri Aurobindo's Savitri, open to newcomers and long-time readers alike.

free_resources.title: Online Sunday Sangha
free_resources.description: A twice-monthly online meeting of Integral Yoga practitioners, each built around one theme from daily practice, such as stillness and presence.
